name: personalisation
description: Wren's PERSONALISATION engine (improvement doc A3). Given a work context, returns which EXPLICIT, CITED Ross preferences apply and WHY (the exact source Ross stated it + which context tokens matched). Reads ONLY Wren's own store data/registries/qsb_wren_ross_preferences.json — never touches Wren's mind and never silently learns. Guardrails: explicit+verified only, inspectable, correctable by Ross, records why, no sensitive learning, preserves Ross's authority. Unknown preferences come back honestly as 'unset' (never guessed). Actions: apply (default, match a context), inspect (list every stored preference + source), correct (Ross-only, cited, appends a correction and preserves history).

context.description: For action=apply: the work context/topic to personalise (e.g. 'about to place a trader order' or 'notify Ross that build finished').

id.description: For action=correct: the preference id to correct.

new_preference.description: For action=correct: Ross's corrected preference text.

source.description: For action=correct: the real Ross message/citation authorizing the correction. REQUIRED — corrections without a cited source are refused.

corrected_by.description: For action=correct: must be 'ross' (only Ross may correct — preserves his authority).

retire.description: For action=correct: mark the preference retired instead of changing its text.
